name: Rod of Rulership

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Command Obedience
powers.text: Magic action (once per dawn): creatures of your choice within 120 ft make a DC 15 Wisdom save or are Charmed by you for 8 hours.

summary: Once a day, creatures of your choice within 120 ft are Charmed by you for 8 hours unless they make a DC 15 Wisdom save.
text: Brandish the rod as a Magic action to demand obedience from any creatures of your choice in sight and within 120 feet. Each must make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 15) or gain the Charmed condition, lasting 8 hours, during which it treats you as its trusted leader. The charm ends early for a target that you or your companions harm, or that is ordered to act against its nature. Once used, the rod is inert until the next dawn.
